## Safety checklist

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, keys, populated `.env` files, or sensitive logs
- [ ] Trading remains disabled by default
- [ ] No live-trading path was enabled
- [ ] Requirements traceability was updated where applicable
- [ ] Codex journal and current state were updated
- [ ] No merge is requested without explicit owner approval
